safetyFeatures: Safety status: idle / active / emergency states
Check-in countdown timer with extend & custom durations
Big SOS trigger that broadcasts to the trusted three
sharingFeatures: Live broadcasting toggle with current location label
Update strategy: normal / low-power / max accuracy
End-to-end encrypted share links with expiry
expensesFeatures: Spend chart over the last 14 days
Auto-logged entries parsed from email + SMS (on-device)
Scan receipt to add an expense
aiFeatures: Daily spend trend (last 7 days) + category breakdown
Avg/day, streaks, by-day and top-merchant stats
Suggested prompts: overspend, forecast, biggest category
Chat answers computed locally — 0 bytes leave the device
tripsFeatures: Current trip card with day X/Y progress
Create a trip: destination, dates, solo or group
Invite companions to a group trip

locationDisclosure.title: Live location sharing uses your location in the background
locationDisclosure.lede: NomadSafe collects your precise location to share it with the trusted contacts you choose — even when the app is closed or not in use — for as long as live sharing is turned on.
locationDisclosure.pointCollect: Your location, battery level and sharing mode are sent to NomadSafe's server while sharing is on. Only your latest position is kept.
locationDisclosure.pointRecipients: Only people who accepted your request can see it. We never sell it or use it for ads.
locationDisclosure.pointNotification: Android shows a persistent notification the whole time your location is being shared.
locationDisclosure.pointStop: Stop anytime from the Sharing tab or the notification. Sharing also stops when you sign out.
locationDisclosure.footnote: Next, Android will ask for location access. Choose “Allow all the time” so sharing keeps working when your screen is off. You can change this later in system settings.
